text: Tomb of Shah Rukhn-I-Alam Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Tomb of Shah Rukhn-I-Alam Type: Monument - Tomb Province: Punjab District: Multan Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1206 - 1526 CE Description: A tomb, octagonal in plan, 27.4 m diameter with pronounced perpendicular walls, and supported by buttresses at the angles with taper towards the top and carried up and crowned with small domed pinnacles, the tomb is constructed of finely burnt bricks of excellent quality and supported by timber framing and decorated with at least ten broad or thin horizontal string courses of cut and dressed bricks, tile faced bricks and wooden beams. The interior of the tomb is decorated with bricks both enameled as well as cut and dressed. The whole structure is divided into three storeys.
